responsibility: Declares the small public interface for parsing `-frust-cfg` command-line arguments in the Rust front end. This header documents the accepted cfg option grammar, exposes `parse_cfg_option` as the helper that decodes a user-supplied string into a cfg key and optional string value, and declares the associated selftest entry point under checking builds.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration/interface side of the cfg-option parser pair: it publishes the `parse_cfg_option` prototype, documents the accepted `-frust-cfg` forms, and declares the selftest entry point. The same-stem `.cc` file provides the actual lexer/parser-based implementation and test bodies.
